content_html:
A bath before going out or an evening «at-home SPA»

You run a warm bath and allow your skin to soften. After soaking for 5-7 minutes, apply the scrub to damp skin. Gently massage areas that are prone to roughness — such as elbows, knees, and thighs — using circular motions, then rinse off. After use, the skin feels smoother, while the shimmer leaves behind a subtle glow that becomes especially noticeable under artificial lighting, making it perfect for an evening-ready look. This effect is achieved through the formula of Be Trendy Magic Party (300 g), which contains food-grade glitters along with exfoliating salt and sugar crystals.

This version of the scrub focuses on two layers of benefits:

  • mechanical exfoliation (salt + sugar) to help smooth and refine skin texture;
  • visual radiance (glitters) that remains on the skin and delivers a "festive" finish. Additionally, the description highlights argan oil (for firmness and elasticity) and coffee extract (to stimulate blood circulation and cell renewal).

Key Benefits of Formulation and Action

1. Two results in one step: you not only exfoliate, but also achieve a visual "glow effect" without the need for a separate shimmer product or oil with glitter.

2. Controlled intensity: salt and sugar provide noticeable exfoliation, but you can easily regulate the "firmness" by adjusting the duration of the massage (shorter application for a gentler effect, longer massage for deeper exfoliation).

3. A more "lifted" skin appearance: texture refinement combined with a built-in anti-cellulite concept (not a claim to "cure," but rather a visible smoothing effect achieved through regular use).

4. Post-Rinse Comfort: the formula contains natural oils, with a particular focus on argan oil, which helps reduce the feeling of dryness or tightness that can sometimes occur after using traditional salt-based scrubs.

 

Why It’s a Customer Favorite

  • If you want your skin to look instantly more radiant after a bath (with a stunning shine, highlighted tan, and a light-reflecting effect) → this formula is perfect, as the glitter is built right into the product.
  • If your priority is visible texture refinement and an instant feeling of smoothness → look into the salt and sugar formula: it provides straightforward mechanical exfoliation.
  • If you have highly sensitive skin or you tend to react to physical scrubs → it is best to look for gentler textures (non-abrasive enzyme or acid exfoliants), as salt and sugar can feel quite active.
  • If you’re primarily looking for a scrub for its sophisticated, niche fragrance that lasts all day, → consider comparing it to the perfumed Be Trendy Marshmallow Vanilla scrub. This formula emphasizes its long-lasting scent and the SALT GLOW blend with other abrasives (salt + apricot pit + rice flour).

 

User Experience: After 10 Days

After 10 days (3 uses), the most noticeable "practical" effect appeared: the skin on the arms and thighs became smoother to the touch, and applying lotion no longer felt like it was "clinging" to dry areas. The shimmer looks delicate — not like large glitter, but rather a soft glow, which is especially visible in the evening under artificial light. Compared to Be Trendy Marshmallow Vanilla, Magic Party feels more like an "event-ready" product: there is less focus on complex aromatics and active ingredients, and more on a visual finish and straightforward salt/sugar exfoliation.

 

Who It Is For and When to Use:

  • If you take a bath/shower before going out and want your skin to look more "toned" and illuminated.
  • If you need one product “both for smoothness and for radiance”, without a separate shimmer product.
  • If you’re looking for supporting skin firmness through nourishing care (with oils, including argan oil).

Who it may NOT be suitable for

  • Those whose skin is easily irritated by physical scrubs (as salt and sugar can be quite active).
  • If you don’t like any shimmer particles on your body — even subtle ones — it’s better to choose a scrub without shimmer.
  • If your goal is purely a perfume-like fragrance that lasts all day, it makes more sense to look at perfumed Be Trendy versions focused on a long-lasting scent trail.
